'''Inafuno Shrine''' (いのうじんじゃ) is a shrine {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=enshrined}} in Inō Nishi, {{ill|Suzuka, Mie|ar|سوزوكا (ميه)|azb|سوزوکا، میه|be|Судзука|bg|Судзука|ca|Suzuka|ce|Судзука (гӀала)|ceb|Suzuka|ckb|سزوکا (میێ)|cs|Suzuka (Mie)|da|Suzuka|de|Suzuka|eo|Suzuka|es|Suzuka (Mie)|et|Suzuka|fa|سوزوکا، میه|fi|Suzuka|fr|Suzuka (Mie)|gl|Suzuka|hu|Szuzuka|hy|Սուձուկա|id|Suzuka, Mie|it|Suzuka|ja|鈴鹿市|ko|스즈카시|lt|Sudzuka|lv|Sudzuka|mg|Suzuka|ms|Suzuka, Mie|mzn|سوزوکا، میه|nl|Suzuka (stad)|no|Suzuka|pl|Suzuka (miasto)|pt|Suzuka|ro|Suzuka|ru|Судзука (город)|sh|Suzuka|simple|Suzuka, Mie|sr|Сузука|sv|Suzuka|tg|Сузука|th|ซูซูกะ|tl|Susuka, Mie|tr|Suzuka, Mie|tt|Судзука (шәһәр)|uk|Судзука (Міє)|ur|سوزوکا، میہ|vi|Suzuka, Mie|war|Suzuka, Mie|zh|鈴鹿市|zh_classical|鈴鹿市|zh_min_nan|Suzuka-chhī|zh_yue|鈴鹿|qid=Q207311}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}. It is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former rank was prefectural shrine.

=== Origin ===
It is said that a divine spirit appeared at Higashi-ga-oka (inside {{ill|Suzuka Circuit|af|Suzuka Internasionale Renbaan|ar|حلبة سوزوكا|ast|Circuitu de Suzuka|bg|Судзука (писта)|ca|Circuit de Suzuka|cs|Suzuka Circuit|da|Suzuka-banen|de|Suzuka International Racing Course|es|Circuito de Suzuka|eu|Suzukako zirkuitua|fa|پیست سوزوکا|fi|Suzuka Circuit|fr|Circuit de Suzuka|fy|Suzuka International Racing Course|gl|Circuíto de Suzuka|hr|Staza Suzuka|hu|Suzuka Circuit|id|Sirkuit Internasional Suzuka|it|Circuito di Suzuka|ja|鈴鹿サーキット|ko|스즈카 서킷|lt|Trasa Suzuka|lv|Sudzukas trase|ms|Litar Suzuka|nl|Suzuka International Racing Course|nn|Suzuka Circuit|no|Suzuka Circuit|pl|Suzuka International Racing Course|pt|Circuito de Suzuka|ro|Circuitul Suzuka|ru|Судзука (трасса)|sco|Suzuka Circuit|simple|Suzuka International Racing Course|sk|Suzuka Circuit|sl|Suzuka Circuit|sr|Сузука (стаза)|sv|Suzuka International Racing Course|th|ซูซูกะเซอร์กิต|tr|Suzuka Pisti|uk|Судзука (траса)|zh|铃鹿赛道|qid=Q174170}}) and was enshrined in the 5th year of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|Q333530|qid=Q333530}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=三重県神社庁 伊奈冨神社|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e4%bc%8a%e5%a5%88%e5%86%a8%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-2}}</ref>. In Jōgan 7 it rose from Senior Fifth Rank Upper to Junior Fourth Rank Lower, and around the mid-{{ill|Kamakura period|Q236205|qid=Q236205}} it advanced to {{ill|Senior First Rank|fa|شوئیچی|ja|正一位|ko|정1위|zh|正一位|qid=Q11123258}}; in Bun'ei 11 it received an imperial plaque and was called "Senior First Rank Inō Daimyōjin"<ref>{{Cite web|title=県神社庁 伊奈冨神社|url=https://jinja-net.jp/jinja-all/jsearch3all.php?jinjya=2998|access-date=2025-12-30}}</ref>.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Principal deity: Ukemochi no Kami Ōkuni no Michi no Mikoto
* Associated deities: Toyoukano-me no Mikoto / {{ill|Wakumusubi|ja|ワクムスヒ|mni|ꯋꯀꯨꯃꯨꯁꯨꯕꯤ|zh|和久產巢日神|qid=Q10921330|lt=Wakumusubi-no-Kami}} / Naruikō-no-Kami / {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōyamazumi-no-Kami}}

=== Annual festival ===
*April 16
*Its ritual is listed in [https://dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/1257927/1/50 Special Rituals in Mie Prefecture]

=== Cultural property ===
The lion kagura is designated as a prefectural {{ill|Intangible Cultural Property (Japan)|fr|Biens culturels immatériels du Japon|ja|無形文化財|tr|Somut Olmayan Kültürel Varlık (Japonya)|qid=Q2901957}}<ref>{{Cite web|title=鈴鹿市|url=https://www.city.suzuka.lg.jp/bunka/bunkazai/1003316.html|access-date=2025-12-31}}</ref>.
